messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT 3923001111: Paging error rate spike in prod after SDK v2.12 canary rollout. Affects streaming/paging endpoints. Severity: P2. Traces: https://telemetry.redwood/incident/3923001111
sam: I'm on pager. seeing 5xx on /v1/stream/page for requests with cursor length >2048. errors ~40% on canary pool.
jen: observed increased latency and sporadic websocket disconnects. rolling back not possible from rollout UI? canary set via ff 'edge_sdk_v2_streaming'
kai: Confirming handshake errors: `tls: unexpected message` from edge-proxy on long-lived streams. blame looks like client-side frame change in v2.12.
alex: Copy. Level set: can we toggle kill-switch? I can flip ff.
maria: Customer impact: 12 customers hitting canary. top affected = 'KiteApps' — 50% of their requests failing, downgrading them to steady 2.11 would drop errors.
sam: Oncall takeover: sam -> jen. Jen you're primary.
jen: Taking it. Steps: 1) kill flag to stop v2.12 canary 2) promote fallback routing 3) notify support to prepare CS template.
alex: Kill switch command (opt):
```
POST /flags/toggle
{
  "flag": "edge_sdk_v2_streaming",
  "state": "off",
  "scope": "canary"
}
```
oncall-bot: HANDOFF: jen is now pager. Escalation: sam -> jen at 3923001500.
jen: Toggling flag now.
jen: :white_check_mark: Flag toggled. Canaries should stop accepting v2.12 traffic. Waiting 30s for drains.
luis: CS note draft: "We've paused the v2.12 canary rollout due to streaming incompatibilities causing paging errors. Engineers are rolling back canary traffic. We will update in 30 minutes."
kai: Telemetry: error-rate dropped from 40% -> 6% in canary pool after flag. still seeing tail errors on long cursors from edge nodes old connections.
sam: Are we rolling back released tarball or just stopping canary? need decision.
jen: Short term: stop canary. Long term: roll back package and patch handshake compatibility. I'll open a release rollback PR. tagging @eng-runtime.
alex: Rolling out automated routing fallback: `route-group: fallback-v2.11` applied to affected customers id list.
maria: Customer impact update: KiteApps restored to <2% error within 3m. total affected customers back to baseline.
jen: I'll coordinate postmortem. Create incident ticket and include steps, RCA: client frame serialization change in v2.12. Patching recommendation: revert frame header change or negotiate version header.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied. Severity downgraded to P3. Next: postmortem in #postmortems. @jen please ping when ready.
sam: thanks team. PR #4523 opened to revert. assigning to @kai for runtime verification.
kai: Will run canary in staging with long cursor e2e. ETA 2h.
alex: Support, please send affected customers a brief with timeline and workaround to pin client to 2.11.
luis: Will do. Sending now.
jen: Closing thread once all customers confirmed stable. last check in 15m.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT HANDOFF END: jen -> offcall at 3923001850.
